note: Publisher schedule config, consumed by scripts/social-publish.mjs. Slot times are FIRST-GUESS defaults (no analytics existed when they were chosen) — revise against real per-platform analytics; this file is the only place the times live. Since 2026-09-22 (the five-a-day feed, docs/social-surface.md §2b) Instagram and the Facebook Page each carry five posts a day, alternating still and reel so no two reels run back to back: morning still, lunch reel, afternoon data post, evening reel, late story carousel. Facebook runs 10 minutes behind Instagram so the two platforms' media fetches never collide. instagram:carousel is the pre-cutover slot (one-reel era manifests); tiktok:carousel still carries the ranking carousel on ranking days.

pinterest.note: board is the Pinterest board ID; unknown until the Pinterest account is connected. Set POSTIZ_PINTEREST_BOARD in the runner's deployment env (docs/social-apps-setup.md §Pinterest) — a null here with no env means Pinterest posts are skipped with a logged reason.

tiktok.note: SELF_ONLY until TikTok's content-posting audit passes (docs/social-apps-setup.md §TikTok); flip privacy_level to PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE after audit.
